claims.text: Episodic TTH: simple analgesics and NSAIDs recommended; caffeine combos = second choice.
claims.quote: Simple analgesics and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs are recommended for the treatment of episodic TTH. Combination analgesics containing caffeine are drugs of second choice.
claims.locator: Bendtsen L, et al. EFNS guideline on the treatment of tension-type headache. Eur J Neurol 2010;17(11):1318-1325

claims.quote: It is crucial to avoid frequent and excessive use of analgesics to prevent the development of medication-overuse headache.
claims.locator: Bendtsen L, et al. EFNS guideline on the treatment of tension-type headache. Eur J Neurol 2010;17(11):1318-1325
